'''Naboo Technologies''' was a localized company on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that specialized in the production of [[Comlink/Legends|personal communications devices]] for use by the military as well as civilians.

They produced the [[Secure-A3 Comlink/Legends|Secure-A3 comlink]].
